response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS value FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.value) AS average_excess_rate FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m WHERE a.rate > m.value;
